svg.aria-label: rETH DEX price against protocol rate and daily mints, May to November 2026
svg.text: DEX price of rETH against the protocol rate, basis points (daily, volume-weighted)
Shaded: under 100 ETH in the rETH contract to pay burns at the start of the day. Triangles: value off the scale.
Top panel: 0 is the protocol rate, which is what a burn pays. The dashed line at +5 is the cost to mint (0.05% deposit fee).
